coexistence.title: Tailscale and NetBird are both configured
coexistence.body: Both overlays use the 100.64.0.0/10 range and can conflict on one host. FreeSDN automatically runs Tailscale with --netfilter-mode=off so they coexist. Trade-off: with netfilter off, Tailscale exit-node and subnet routing stop working — if you need those, set FREESDN_TAILSCALE_NETFILTER_MODE=on and accept the NetBird conflict risk. If a device on one overlay is unreachable, reconnect Tailscale and avoid overlapping peer IPs across the two networks.
